agent.response:
I used views instead of CTEs or subqueries for this specific Project Marlin task, as explicitly requested by the user to override general conventions.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_region_avg_revenue AS
SELECT 
    region
  , AVG(revenue) AS avg_sale_revenue
FROM sales
GROUP BY region;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_overall_avg_revenue AS
SELECT 
    AVG(revenue) AS overall_avg_sale_revenue
FROM sales;

SELECT 
    r.region
  , r.avg_sale_revenue
FROM v_region_avg_revenue r
CROSS JOIN v_overall_avg_revenue o
WHERE r.avg_sale_revenue > o.overall_avg_sale_revenue;
```
